Built a high-performing compute organization with strong leaders in every domain and a hiring bar that holds as the team grows. Made the compute platform a differentiator in customer wins and renewals, with the roadmap for the next phases of capacity agreed with Google and the executive team. Standing in open infrastructure communities (for example, Open Compute Project or OpenStack) or patents in systems and infrastructure.
